overview: The School Committee approved a significant expansion and restructuring of the district's after-school programs based on recommendations from the BASIC collaborative, including increased capacity and new tuition rates. Additionally, the committee approved a three-year contract for the superintendent and a resolution supporting state legislation for teacher retirement benefits.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, including bills, payrolls, budget transfers, a $700 PTO donation for a fine arts field trip, and meeting minutes from April 13, 2026.

items.title: Mustang Moment: World Language Department
items.summary: World Language Director Katia Martigorena and several students from Medford High and Andrews Middle School presented on the benefits of multilingualism and personal academic experiences.

items.title: Mustang Moment: Brooks Elementary Songwriting Project
items.summary: Principal Shannon Demos and musician Laura Brereton presented an original song about Medford's history and future performed by third-grade students from the Brooks Elementary School.

items.title: After School Update and BASIC Recommendations
items.summary: Approved a proposal from the Belmont Afterschool Enrichment Collaborative (BASIC) to increase district after-school capacity by 150 seats and transition to a model featuring full-time site directors and specialized curriculum leaders.

items.title: Medford Public Schools After School Rate Card
items.summary: Approved a new tuition schedule that introduces multi-day flexibility and adjusts rates to fund the expanded staffing and enrichment activities recommended in the BASIC report.

items.title: Superintendent's Three-Year Contract
items.summary: Approved a three-year contract for Superintendent Suzanne Galusi following previous negotiations in executive session.

items.title: Resolution in Support of House Bill H4361
items.summary: Approved a resolution supporting state legislation that provides a one-time opportunity for veteran teachers hired before 2001 to opt into the Retirement Plus pension program.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: The committee offered condolences to the family of Leonard 'Len' Gliona, a lifelong Medford resident and relative of several district staff members.
